g.text: SD04 - Correction, combined and timed replacement (UC04 / UC05; F06-F09)
Current held set = {RIGHT}; a timer may be active.
New input enters through GUI voice or either frontend's text input.
Input handling, accepted completions and timer expiry share one application loop.
Alternatives below correspond to the example inputs "right no left",
"up and right", and "a little left", respectively.
SD01 / SD02: async DecisionModel -> local SemIf -> stamped ActionDecision
[older inference finishes after the new input]
[same semantic decision in the same utterance]
true; existing timer is not restarted
Preserve held directions, timer and lastMovement.
Compute complete desired direction set from the
pre-cancel held snapshot. Opposed pairs are invalid.
Plan KeyUp for unwanted directions and KeyDown for
every desired direction, or one new TimedPressCommand.
[a previous timed press is still active]
Invalid current schemas or current inference failures invoke failCurrent():
invalidateControls() releases inputs, clears history and stops voice capture.
Stale failures are ignored. There is no independent timer callback or AI game mutation.
